Title: Valid login
Preconditions: Registered user, app on login screen
Steps: 1. Enter valid email 2. Enter valid password 3. Tap Sign in
Expected Result: User reaches the home screen; session token stored

Title: Wrong password
Steps: 1. Enter valid email 2. Enter wrong password 3. Tap Sign in
Expected Result: Inline error shown; user stays on login; no token stored

Title: Offline login attempt
Steps: 1. Enter valid credentials 2. Tap Sign in
Expected Result: Clear ""no connection"" message; retry offered; nothing submitted

Title: Correct answer scores full
Preconditions: In a graded question, answer is correct
Expected Result: Score recorded as full value for that item; total updates after save confirms

Title: Grader unavailable
Steps: 1. Submit an answer 2. Marking call fails
Expected Result: Item left UNMARKED (not 0); retry shown; user not penalised for the outage

Title: Result shown only after save
Expected Result: Result/coins appear only after the server confirms the save (201)
